name: felixhaeberle/kirby3-webp
description: WebP & AVIF for Kirby — automatic companion files on upload, responsive <picture> helpers and CLI bulk conversion. Compatible with Kirby 4 and Kirby 5.

suggest.rosell-dk/webp-convert: Converter stack (cwebp, vips, imagick, gd) used automatically for WebP when installed — useful on servers whose GD lacks WebP support
suggest.getkirby/cli: Enables the kirby webp:generate and kirby webp:clean commands
